title: Preview-docs concurrency key must include head repository, not only head branch
answers: docs preview for a fork PR deploys over or cancels another PR's preview
preview docs artifacts clobbered by PRs using the same branch name
why does preview-docs group include head_repository full_name
branch name master collides across forks
body:
Symptom: A docs preview from one pull request is skipped, overwritten, or its cleanup is wrongly run when another pull request uses a common branch name such as master.
Root cause: .github/workflows/preview-docs.yml concurrency.group was built from `github.event.workflow_run.head_branch` alone; branch names are not unique across forks.
Fix pattern: Include `github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name` in the group key alongside `github.workflow` and `head_branch`, so only successive runs for the same fork branch serialize.
Constraints: Applies to any workflow_run-triggered workflow keyed on head_branch. Keeping cancel-in-progress false is still required; the key only chooses which runs share a queue.
applies: Workflows triggered by workflow_run that derive concurrency or artifact naming from head_branch.
says: Documentation preview builds get overwritten when separate pull requests share the same branch name.
A documentation preview was unexpectedly canceled while another contributor submitted changes from their fork.
Prevent pull request documentation previews from conflicting when external authors use default branch names.
Merging or updating one pull request prematurely deleted the documentation preview of another pull request.
Isolate preview site generation so forked contributions do not overwrite each other's preview deployments.
search: In .github/workflows/preview-docs.yml, concurrency.group must include github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name alongside github.workflow and head_branch. This prevents documentation preview runs from different forks colliding, cancelling, or overwriting artifacts when pull requests share identical branch names such as master. This rule applies to any workflow_run-triggered workflow keyed on head_branch, while cancel-in-progress must remain false.
